name: Twilio
compatibility_note: The identifier travels as an operator-supplied parameter on the call or message the agent places, and comes back on the status webhook, where the operator's own handler resolves and re-verifies it with @agenid/core. Twilio carries the value as opaque data: it ships no AgenID code, performs no verification, and attaches no meaning to the field.
capabilities: Identifier attached to an agent-placed call or message
Returned on the status webhook for out-of-band verification
Twilio treats the value as opaque and verifies nothing
